applications.name: Solar cells and photovoltaics
applications.what_to_look_for: band gap in the 1.1-1.8 eV window (single junction) or 1.6-2.0 eV (tandem top cell), direct gap, strong absorption, formation energy / hull distance, defect tolerance, device records for the experimental side
applications.meidnet_targets: dir_gap or any gap column + heat_all / e_above_hull; family = perovskite_abx3 (halide, oxide, chalcogenide), or your own prototype

applications.name: Semiconductor physics
applications.what_to_look_for: band gaps at several levels of theory (PBE, HSE, mBJ) and experimental, effective masses, dielectric constants, carrier mobility proxies, band edges, phonons
applications.meidnet_targets: gap, effective mass or dielectric constant as scalar targets; keep the level of theory consistent inside one table

applications.name: Batteries and ionic conductors
applications.what_to_look_for: ionic conductivity, migration barriers, voltage, stability window, volume change, hull distance
applications.meidnet_targets: formation energy + conductivity (log scale) as targets; families with a mobile-ion site group

applications.name: Thermoelectrics
applications.what_to_look_for: Seebeck coefficient, electrical and thermal conductivity, zT, carrier concentration and temperature; experimental data is temperature-resolved
applications.meidnet_targets: zT or Seebeck at a fixed temperature as a scalar target

applications.name: Catalysis and surfaces
applications.what_to_look_for: adsorption energies, reaction barriers, surface energies, work functions
applications.meidnet_targets: bulk descriptors (formation energy, d-band proxies) only - MEIDNet works on bulk prototypes, not slabs

applications.name: Magnetism and superconductivity
applications.what_to_look_for: magnetic moment and ordering, Curie / Neel temperature, superconducting Tc with the structure it belongs to
applications.meidnet_targets: total magnetization per formula unit, Tc (log scale) as scalar targets

applications.name: Mechanical, dielectric and piezoelectric
applications.what_to_look_for: bulk and shear moduli, hardness, dielectric tensor, piezoelectric coefficients, phonon stability
applications.meidnet_targets: bulk modulus, dielectric constant or a piezoelectric scalar as targets

applications.name: 2D materials
applications.what_to_look_for: exfoliation energy, gap, magnetic state, dynamic stability of monolayers
applications.meidnet_targets: a 2D prototype family (e.g. MXene or TMD) with gap and exfoliation energy as targets

applications.name: Porous materials and MOFs
applications.what_to_look_for: pore geometry, gas uptake, band gap of the framework, stability
applications.meidnet_targets: frameworks exceed MEIDNet's cell-size limit today (max_sites); use the property tables to set targets and the descriptors as inspiration

applications.name: Generative-model benchmarks
applications.what_to_look_for: fixed splits used by CDVAE, DiffCSP, MatterGen and MEIDNet; validity, uniqueness, novelty and stability metrics
applications.meidnet_targets: the Perov-5 split is the published MEIDNet benchmark; MP-20 and Carbon-24 test structure representation

databases.name: Materials Project
databases.features: relaxed structures, formation energy, energy above hull, PBE/r2SCAN band gaps, magnetic ordering, elastic / dielectric / piezoelectric tensors, phonons for a subset, X-ray absorption, battery (intercalation) electrodes
databases.meidnet: ready: export CIFs + a property table with the API; one prototype family per table

databases.name: OQMD
databases.features: formation energy, stability (hull), band gap (PBE), many hypothetical prototypes (Heusler, perovskite, ...)
databases.meidnet: ready: prototype-decorated entries are exactly what a MEIDNet family describes

databases.name: AFLOW
databases.features: formation enthalpy, band gaps, elastic and thermal properties (AGL), Debye temperature, magnetic moments, prototype encyclopedia
databases.meidnet: ready; the AFLOW prototype library is a good source of family files

databases.name: JARVIS-DFT (NIST)
databases.features: OptB88vdW and TBmBJ band gaps, effective masses, dielectric functions, solar-cell efficiency (SLME), elastic tensors, piezoelectric and thermoelectric (BoltzTraP) properties, exfoliation energies, superconducting Tc (electron-phonon) for a subset
databases.meidnet: ready; the richest single source of scalar targets per structure

databases.name: Alexandria
databases.size: about 4,500,000 PBE and 400,000 PBEsol / SCAN structures
databases.features: formation energy, hull distance, band gap, magnetic moment, for a very large set of hypothetical compounds (1D, 2D, 3D)
databases.meidnet: ready; the usual pre-training set of generative models (MatterGen's Alex-MP-20 split)

databases.name: GNoME (DeepMind)
databases.features: structures predicted stable with DFT energies and hull distances; no electronic properties
databases.meidnet: structures only: join with a computed property before training

databases.name: NOMAD
databases.features: raw and normalised DFT outputs from many codes; band structures, DOS, energies; FAIR provenance
databases.meidnet: needs curation: pick one code and functional before building a table

databases.name: Materials Cloud
databases.features: MC3D relaxed structures, MC2D exfoliable monolayers, phonon database, Sssp pseudopotential sets, workflow provenance (AiiDA)
databases.meidnet: ready for MC3D / MC2D tables

databases.name: C2DB
databases.features: stability (dynamic and thermodynamic), PBE / HSE / GW gaps, magnetic state, optical absorption, piezoelectric and Raman data for monolayers
databases.meidnet: ready for a 2D prototype family

databases.name: 2DMatPedia
databases.features: exfoliation energy, band gap, magnetic moment of monolayers derived from bulk databases
databases.meidnet: ready for a 2D prototype family

databases.name: Cubic perovskites (CMR, Castelli et al.)
databases.features: formation (heat of formation) energies and direct / indirect gaps (GLLB-SC) for cubic ABX3 with O, N, S, F anions and their mixtures - the source of Perov-5
databases.meidnet: the published MEIDNet benchmark (Perov-5 split): meidnet download-data

databases.name: CDVAE splits (Perov-5, MP-20, Carbon-24)
databases.features: fixed train / val / test splits used by generative-model papers; Perov-5 carries formation energy and band gap, the others energies only
databases.meidnet: ready: the format meidnet reads directly (id, cif, property columns)

databases.name: Matbench
databases.features: standardised property-prediction tasks (band gap, formation energy, moduli, dielectric constant, ...) with fixed cross-validation folds
databases.meidnet: use the structure-based tasks as property tables

databases.name: matminer datasets
databases.features: one-line loaders for experimental band gaps (Zhuo 2018, 6,354 compounds; matbench_expt_gap 4,604), experimental formation enthalpies (Kim 2017), UCSB thermoelectrics, elastic tensors, dielectric constants, piezoelectric tensors, phonon data, superhard materials, HOIP perovskites
databases.meidnet: experimental tables are composition-only: join with a structure source (COD, Materials Project) to train; use them directly as realistic targets

databases.name: Crystallography Open Database (COD)
databases.features: experimentally determined structures (organic and inorganic) as CIFs with references; no properties
databases.meidnet: structures: join with a property table to train; the natural source of experimental prototypes for family files

databases.name: ICSD
databases.features: the reference collection of experimentally determined inorganic structures; the ground truth most DFT databases start from
databases.meidnet: structures: licence forbids redistribution, train locally

databases.name: Cambridge Structural Database (CSD)
databases.size: more than 1,300,000 organic and metal-organic structures
databases.features: experimental molecular and MOF crystal structures
databases.meidnet: beyond today's cell-size limit; descriptors only

databases.name: Perovskite Database Project
databases.features: device-level records: composition, architecture, efficiency, Voc, Jsc, FF, stability, processing conditions, from the literature
databases.meidnet: no crystal structures per record: use it to choose realistic gap / composition targets and to check candidates against what has been made

databases.name: Hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites (Kim et al. 2017)
databases.features: DFT structures, band gaps and dielectric constants of ABX3 hybrid perovskites
databases.meidnet: ready, but organic A-site cations need a family file with molecular site groups (not shipped)

databases.name: Experimental band gaps (Zhuo et al. 2018)
databases.features: measured band gaps by composition, with the matbench_expt_gap subset as a standard task
databases.meidnet: targets and validation of predicted gaps; no structures

databases.name: Liverpool Ionic Conductivity Database (LiIonDB)
databases.features: experimental Li-ion conductivities with temperature and the reported phase, from the literature
databases.meidnet: targets (log conductivity); join with COD / Materials Project structures

databases.name: Materials Project battery explorer
databases.features: average voltage, capacity, volume change and stability of intercalation electrodes computed from the MP structures
databases.meidnet: ready: voltage and capacity as targets on the host-structure family

databases.name: UCSB thermoelectrics (Gaultois et al.)
databases.features: experimental Seebeck, resistivity, thermal conductivity, zT at a given temperature
databases.meidnet: targets; join with structures

databases.name: Starrydata
databases.size: tens of thousands of digitised curves
databases.features: temperature-dependent thermoelectric and other property curves digitised from papers
databases.meidnet: targets at a chosen temperature

databases.name: Open Catalyst (OC20 / OC22)
databases.features: adsorbate-surface relaxations with energies and forces; the standard catalysis ML benchmark
databases.meidnet: surfaces are out of MEIDNet's scope; use the bulk subsets as structure sources

databases.name: Catalysis-Hub
databases.features: adsorption and reaction energies on surfaces with the DFT settings used
databases.meidnet: descriptors only

databases.name: SuperCon (NIMS) and 3DSC
databases.size: about 16,000 Tc entries; 3DSC links 5,700 to structures
databases.features: experimental superconducting critical temperatures; 3DSC matches them to ICSD / Materials Project structures
databases.meidnet: 3DSC is ready (structure + Tc); use log Tc as the target

databases.name: MAGNDATA (Bilbao)
databases.features: experimentally determined commensurate and incommensurate magnetic structures
databases.meidnet: structures with magnetic ordering; join with moments as targets

databases.name: QMOF
databases.features: DFT-optimised MOF structures with band gaps and charges
databases.meidnet: beyond today's cell-size limit; targets and descriptors

databases.name: CoRE MOF
databases.features: computation-ready experimental MOF structures with pore descriptors
databases.meidnet: beyond today's cell-size limit

databases.name: Materials Data Facility
databases.features: a registry of published materials datasets, experimental and computed, with DOIs
databases.meidnet: a place to find and to publish tables
